device.description: 24-bit 20.8 kSPS 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with 2-wire serial interface (DOUT/DRDY, SCLK)
device.note: ads1253.pdf (SBAS199B) p.2-3 electrical characteristics (data rate 20.8 kHz, VDD 4.75-5.25 V), p.3 pin configuration and descriptions, p.7 channel selection (Table I), p.9-11 DOUT/DRDY, synchronization, p.12 power-down, serial interface, data format (Table IV), Table III digital timing

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the CHSEL1/CHSEL0 pin levels (Table I: 00 = CH1, 01 = CH2, 10 = CH3, 11 = CH4)

pages: p.2-3 electrical characteristics (data rate 20.8 kHz, VDD 4.75-5.25 V), p.3 pin configuration and descriptions, p.7 channel selection (Table I), p.9-11 DOUT/DRDY, synchronization, p.12 power-down, serial interface, data format (Table IV), Table III digital timing
notModeled: conversion cycle tDRDY = 384 CLK = 48 us at the nominal CLK = 8 MHz; the data rate scales with CLK (the CLK pin is not used)

DOUT/DRDY partitioning: DRDY mode (t4 high 24 CLK, t2 low pulse 6 CLK = 750 ns, t3 high 6 CLK) then DOUT mode with the MSB on the pin (t7); modeled as an active-low ready pulse of t2 followed by the data; the t3 high period and t4 high before the next DRDY are not modeled
after more than 24 SCLKs DOUT/DRDY stays low until t4 (idle '0'); after an incomplete read the last bit read stays on the pin
synchronization (SCLK held high for 4 to 20 DOUT/DRDY periods resets the modulator) and power-down (SCLK held high for 20 periods; released on SCLK falling)
digital filter settling (5 to 6 conversions after a step; first valid data after power-up / sync)
channel selection by CHSEL1/CHSEL0 (stored only; every channel returns the 0 V code); a channel change resets the conversion and holds DOUT/DRDY high for t18 = 2043.5 tOSC
variants: ADS1250-ADS1254 family: ADS1251 (20.8 kHz, 1 input), ADS1252 (41.7 kHz, 1 input), ADS1253 (20.8 kHz, 4 inputs) have separate datasheets and spec files
